RAG and local deployment represent distinct approaches to addressing the challenges of question answering. RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) leverages the retrieved documents to generate answers, while local deployment utilizes the retrieved documents directly for answering.  The key difference lies in how the model handles the question. RAG focuses on providing answers based on the content of the retrieved documents, while local deployment allows the model to generate answers from scratch using the retrieved information.
